# Question: Identity verification question

## Question

Is identity verification required before a prospective customer can complete the F-001 account creation step?

## Evidence Required

A documented eligibility or identity-verification rule for the fictional onboarding flow.

## Why Evidence Is Missing

The available fictional demonstration records define email and terms acceptance but do not define identity verification timing.

## Impact

The requirement cannot be included in F-001 or US-001 without evidence.

## Resolution

Unresolved. Link a verified source here when it becomes available.
